ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Child Care Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the potential for fraud in the child care system and the impact of the federal funding freeze on low-income families.
questions: What is the extent of the federal funding freeze on child care funds?
How has the freeze impacted low-income families?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover widespread fraud in the child care system and highlight the impact of the federal funding freeze on vulnerable families.
